name: prose-minion
description: AI prose analysis and writing assistant for fiction authors. Dialogue suggestions, context-aware dictionary, comprehensive prose metrics, style flags, word frequency, and manuscript search. Metrics/search work offline—no API key needed.

proseMinion.assistantModel.description: AI model for assistant tools (Prose/Dialogue analysis). See Settings Overlay for curated list, or enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.dictionaryModel.description: AI model for dictionary and utility tools. See Settings Overlay for curated list, or enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.contextModel.description: AI model for context bot features. See Settings Overlay for curated list, or enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.widgetModel.description: AI model for quality-first Conversation Widget generation (for example, Gesture Playground's semantic scan and alternatives). Enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.lightboxModel.markdownDescription: AI model for the Lightbox's analyses. Leave empty to use the same model as the Workshop (`#proseMinion.assistantModel#`), following it when it changes. Choosing a model here, or in the Lightbox's model picker, gives the Lightbox its own, and never changes the Workshop's. Enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.proofreadModel.markdownDescription: AI model for Proofread (the editor's right-click **Prose Minion: Proofread** commands). Proofreading wants precise, repeatable corrections across many small calls, so the default is a fast, inexpensive model. Enter any OpenRouter model ID.

proseMinion.craftModel.markdownDescription: AI model for Craft Flags (the editor's right-click **Prose Minion: Craft Flags** command), which reads a whole chapter and flags line notes such as clichés and shifts of register. Leave empty to use the same model as the Workshop (`#proseMinion.assistantModel#`), following it when it changes. Choosing a model here gives Craft Flags its own, and never changes the Workshop's. Enter any OpenRouter model ID.

enumDescriptions: Cliché: a phrase worn smooth by use, standing in for something the scene could name exactly.
Register shift: narration that leaves the register the chapter keeps, such as slang in formal narration or a modern word in a period one.
Gesture strain: a gesture a reader stumbles on: one the body cannot make, choreography to assemble, a stock beat the chapter leans on, or one that names its own body part.
Continuity: two places in the chapter that cannot both be true, such as eyes that change colour or a seated character still standing, never across a scene break.

proseMinion.craftFlags.categories.markdownDescription: Which line notes **Prose Minion: Craft Flags** looks for. Each one is a request of its own, priced in the confirmation before anything is sent. Words inside quotation marks are always left alone; a gesture in a dialogue beat is narration, and is read.

enumDescriptions: No thinking: the model answers at once. Refused, with nothing sent, on a model that always thinks.
A little thinking: a budget of about 1,000 tokens.
Some thinking: a budget of about 4,000 tokens.
Much thinking: a budget of about 12,000 tokens; slower and costlier.
proseMinion.craftFlags.reasoning.markdownDescription: How much a thinking model may think before it reads the chapter for each **Prose Minion: Craft Flags** category. The budget comes on top of the reply's own room, and the confirmation's price counts typical thinking. Models differ: some take only a rough level. A model the OpenRouter catalog marks as always thinking cannot be asked for `off`: Craft Flags then sends nothing and says so, and you choose a level or another model. Models that do not think ignore this.

enumDescriptions: Open Refactor Preview with each fix as a change to tick; nothing changes until you tick and Apply.
Apply the safe fixes at once, as one change you can undo.
proseMinion.proofread.fixReview.markdownDescription: How **Prose Minion: Proofread and Fix**, and the *Fix all* quick fix, bring their fixes to the file. Either way the fixes are one undoable change and the file is never saved for you, and tense and agreement issues are only ever flagged. A single *Replace with* quick fix always applies at once.

enumDescriptions: No convention chosen: a spelling correct in American, British, Canadian or Australian English is never flagged, unless the text mixes them.
American English spelling.
British English spelling.
Canadian English spelling.
Australian English spelling.
proseMinion.proofread.spellingConvention.markdownDescription: The spelling **Prose Minion: Proofread** holds your text to. With a convention named, a word spelled to another one (*colour* or *color*) is flagged, and **Proofread and Fix** corrects it when the change is small. With `auto`, only a spelling that breaks the text's own pattern is flagged. Proper names keep their own spelling. When a file writes a word both ways (*grey* and *gray*), the convention's spelling is the one kept; with `auto`, the more used.

proseMinion.proofread.wordList.markdownDescription: Names and invented words **Prose Minion: Proofread** accepts as spelled: never flagged as a spelling or wrong word, in any case or with a possessive (*Dinah's*), and never flagged as a variant of another name or as a word spelled two ways. An entry of several words counts word by word. Set it in your workspace settings to keep a list per project.

enumDescriptions: No thinking: the model answers at once. Refused, with nothing sent, on a model that always thinks.
A little thinking: a budget of about 1,000 tokens.
Some thinking: a budget of about 4,000 tokens.
Much thinking: a budget of about 12,000 tokens; slower and costlier.
proseMinion.proofread.reasoning.markdownDescription: How much a thinking model may think before it proofreads each passage. The budget comes on top of the reply's own room, so thinking never cuts a reply short on a model that honors it. Models differ: some take only a rough level. A model the OpenRouter catalog marks as always thinking cannot be asked for `off`: Proofread then sends nothing and says so, and you choose a level or another model. If a reply is still cut off, the Output panel says how much went to thinking. Models that do not think ignore this.

proseMinion.categoryModel.description: AI model for Category Search (curated list)

proseMinion.includeCraftGuides.description: Include craft guides in AI prompts (provides additional writing guidance but uses more tokens)

proseMinion.ui.showTokenWidget.description: Show the session token usage widget in the header (tokens and optional cost).

enumDescriptions: Follow your active VS Code color theme (default).
Prose Minion's pinned warm-dark brand palette.
proseMinion.ui.sidebarTheme.description: Sidebar palette: follow your active VS Code color theme (the default), or pin Prose Minion's warm-dark brand look. Also toggleable from the header.

proseMinion.temperature.description: AI creativity level (0 = focused, 2 = very creative)

enumDescriptions: 5 minutes; cache writes cost 1.25× normal input.
1 hour; cache writes cost 2× normal input (60% more than 5 minutes).
proseMinion.claudeCacheTtl.description: Cache duration for retained Claude conversations. Reuse refreshes the window. Cache-read pricing is unchanged. Applies to subsequent requests.

proseMinion.contextPaths.characters.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for character reference files (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.locations.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for setting/location files (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.themes.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for theme notebooks (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.things.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for important objects or props (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.chapters.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for draft chapters and outlines (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.manuscript.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for polished manuscript chapters (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.projectBrief.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for project brief materials (only .md and .txt files are used).

proseMinion.contextPaths.general.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for general reference material (only .md and .txt files are used).

expressionLevel.description: How audibly the selected persona expresses their authored voice, from quiet to deliberately amplified.

relationalDepth.description: How deeply Workshop personas may interpret and respond to emotional cues and explicitly shared personal context.

carryCuesThroughSession.description: Allow demonstrated interaction preferences to shape later turns in the current Workshop session.

proactiveAssistance.description: Encourage Workshop personas to offer one relevant tool or prepare one live widget when it would materially help.

proseMinion.workshop.conversationBehavio.description: Durable defaults for Workshop conversation behavior. These explicit choices survive restart; inferred conversation-cue memory remains session-scoped.

enabled.description: Share this profile with Workshop personas. Empty profiles remain inactive.

preferredAddress.description: How Workshop personas should address you.

bio.description: Writer-authored context for Workshop personas (up to 20,000 characters). Longer profiles consume more prompt context. Stored globally; do not include sensitive information.

proseMinion.workshop.writerProfile.description: Optional global writer profile shared only with Workshop personas. It is not session memory and is not copied into project data.

enabled.description: Allow Workshop personas to use live web research when current information helps. Queries can draw on room context and are processed by OpenRouter and search providers; enable only for material you are comfortable sharing. May add latency and charges.

proseMinion.workshop.webResearch.description: Optional per-window live-web research for Workshop persona conversations. Research may share active conversation context with OpenRouter and search providers. Workshop tools remain unchanged.

proseMinion.publishingStandards.preset.description: Publishing standards preset for Metrics comparison: 'none', 'manuscript', or 'genre:<abbreviation|name|slug>'.

proseMinion.publishingStandards.pageSize.description: Selected trim size key for the chosen genre (uses page_sizes[].format when available, otherwise WIDTHxHEIGHT).

proseMinion.wordFrequency.topN.description: Top N words to include in the Word Frequency report.

proseMinion.wordFrequency.includeHapaxLi.description: Include the Hapax (frequency=1) word list at the bottom of the Word Frequency report.

proseMinion.wordFrequency.hapaxDisplayMa.description: Maximum Hapax words to display inline in the report (full list still counted).

proseMinion.wordFrequency.includeStopwor.description: Include a Top Stopwords table with counts and percentages.

proseMinion.wordFrequency.contentWordsOn.description: Show Top Words using content words only (excludes stopwords).

proseMinion.wordFrequency.posEnabled.description: Enable POS sections using wink-pos-tagger. If the tagger cannot initialize, sections are marked unavailable.

proseMinion.wordFrequency.enableLemmas.description: Enable a lemmatized Top Words view (experimental).

proseMinion.wordFrequency.lengthHistogra.description: Maximum token length to show in the Word Length Distribution histogram.

proseMinion.wordFrequency.minCharacterLe.markdownDescription: Minimum character length for words in Word Frequency results. Filter helps identify longer, more distinctive word patterns by excluding short common words. **1+** = all words, **3+** = excludes 'it', 'is', 'an', **5+** = multi-syllable words, **6+** = distinctive vocabulary, **7+** = complex words, **8+** = advanced vocabulary, **9+** = rare/specialized words. Applied to Top Words, POS, Bigrams/Trigrams, Hapax List, and Lemmas. Does NOT filter Stop Words or Length Histogram.

proseMinion.wordSearch.contextWords.description: Number of words to show around each word search match for context

proseMinion.wordSearch.clusterWindow.description: Maximum word distance to group matches into a cluster

proseMinion.wordSearch.minClusterSize.description: Minimum number of matches required to form a cluster

proseMinion.wordSearch.enableAssistantEx.description: Enable assistant-based expansion for target words (synonyms, inflections).

proseMinion.applyContextWindowTrimming.markdownDescription: Apply context window trimming to prevent token limit errors. **Limits**: UI recommends 500-word excerpts; Context Agent (50K words), Analysis Agents (75K words total: excerpt + context + guides). Targets 128K token context window. Disable if using models with larger context windows (e.g., 200K+).

proseMinion.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Log full rejected AI responses to the Output channel for protocol diagnosis. **Privacy**: these dumps may quote your manuscript text — leave off unless debugging, and avoid pasting the Output channel into public bug reports while enabled.

proseMinion.categorySearch.ngramMode.description: Default search mode for new searches. Words = individual words, Bigrams = 2-word phrases, Trigrams = 3-word phrases. Changes take effect on panel reload.

proseMinion.categorySearch.minPhraseOccu.description: Default minimum phrase occurrences for bigram/trigram searches. Phrases appearing fewer times are filtered out. Changes take effect on panel reload.

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run copy:resources && webpack --mode production && npm run verify:bundle
